text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Queen Elizabeth II Cup is finally 
about to begin. Aiming for the greatest 
finale, Fine Motion vows to run a race 
that will linger in everyone's hearts.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Air Groove asks, "Are you prepared to face 
this 'Empress'?" Fine Motion smiles, 
saying of course she is.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A long-awaited rematch on a proud, grand 
stage. Now, the curtains rise on this 
battle—!
